labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.note: Every node and the load generator share this machine's CPUs and its one disk: more nodes means more processes competing for them. These numbers compare configurations on one machine; they do not measure scaling out.
labels.title: Cluster size
labels.what: One standalone node, then three and five nodes with every shard on three of them (RF 3).
